bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the robustness of rationale evaluation metrics by comparing their scores on genuine human-annotated rationales versus synthetic rationales that spuriously correlate with the target (e.g., verbatim restating the label or using vacuous declarative combinations). The paper measures how much metrics artificially inflate scores due to these dataset artifacts and mitigates this using gradient-based attribution, counterfactual editing, and Invariant Risk Minimization (IRM).
